programs.description: Rajkumar's mother sets out to oppose his marriage after she finds out that he plans to marry the rival kingdom's princess.
Jaswant is arrested and tortured for a crime he did not commit. On seeing his friend's condition, Kripal joins an extremist group in order to bring down the government.
Vishwanath, an honest lawyer, is framed and imprisoned due to a gangster. After his release, he sets out to seek revenge and ends up becoming a criminal.
Kalpana, a habitual liar, attempts to sabotage her sister's arranged marriage to a doctor, but complications arise when she develops feelings for him.
Sagar sets out to exact revenge against Dr Narendra, a smuggler who killed his father. But Sagar is soon framed for the murder of a woman and sent to jail.
Sonam's night of celebration turns into a disaster when her car hits an innocent man. Afraid of being punished for the crime, she decides to hide him but invites trouble in turn.
Talented dancer, Barkha, saves the life of an underground crime boss, VK, who offers her a job as repayment. Later VK falls for Barkha, but she is in love with another man.

Amar, a rich businessman, is framed by two undercover police officers, Seema and Jagmohan, for the murder of his uncle. To evade prison, he claims to be of unsound mind and tries to solve the mystery.
After losing his job owing to his arrogance and subsequently his son, Vijay, Atmaram realises his mistake and decides to turn over a new leaf.
Karan, a gangster, falls in love with Kajal, but she marries Raju because of her father's poor health. Later, when Raju finds out about his father's illegal business, Karan is hired to kill him.
Shaamu, who lives a carefree life, falls in love with a well-educated girl, Raadha. However, circumstances force the young couple to part ways.

Two siblings, Radha and Ramu, belong to a poor family. Their life takes an unexpected turn when a tragic incident leaves them orphaned.
Twin brothers separated at birth become best friends, unaware of their bond as siblings. The queen, their mother, becomes the uniting force as they set out to defeat their evil uncle.
Mangal Singh escapes prison and begins a new life, unknowingly befriending his victim's family. As he seeks redemption, his past catches up, compelling him to confront his previous misdeeds.
D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.
Raja, a young man, wants an easy life and marries for wealth and comfort. He soon finds out that there is an underlying secret of his wife and feels trapped.
Geeta is expecting a baby but tragedy strikes and she loses her child. When she finds a little boy, she adopts him as her own, but the boy's family accuses her of kidnapping.
Salman and Rukhsar's love brings two warring families face to face, only for tradition, dowry demands and heartbreak to test their fragile bond.
Vicky plans to marry Aarti, but his dreams are crushed when an incident causes her to lose her life. Fuelled by revenge, Vicky finds himself going down a dark path.
Inder and Pallavi fall for each other but her three possessive brothers hate him. Resultantly, the couple elopes, but they soon find themselves missing their families and decide to return.
Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community.

A jailer's daughter falls for a prisoner poet, believing him wrongly convicted and strives to prove his innocence and secure his release.
Sushma escapes from her arranged marriage and embarks on an adventure that changes her life forever. Along the way, she encounters several men, each embodying different aspects of human life.

Anuradha relocates to Mumbai where she meets Vivek, an aspiring politician, and marries him. Things take a turn when he is arrested for murder, and she has to take his place in the upcoming elections.
Kailash's uncle discovers a formula to save energy, which could make him very wealthy. Mr Mehta, an industrialist, envies his success and devises an evil plan to steal the formula.
Raj, an aspiring singer, rescues Pooja, the daughter of a wealthy man, from an accident. However, he soon finds himself in a web of complications when he falls in love with her best friend.
Two brothers struggle to keep their family together as external forces like the younger brother's father-in-law try to break them apart.
A wife embraces her husband's illegitimate son as her own in honour of the other woman's memory. However, as time progresses, this starts to seem like a big mistake.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
Sooraj Dhanrajgir, a playboy, falls in love with Komal, who rejects him because of his vices and gives him time to change. Things go awry when a little boy shows up claiming to be his son.
A young man falls for a woman from the red-light district, but their love faces opposition and threat from powerful figures.

An idealist elder brother lands in a dilemma after he misplaces his little sister's shoes. Unable to afford a new pair, the siblings agree to share the shoes, leading to several escapades.
Friends Shankar and Shambhu share a lot in common and also end up falling in love with the same girl. However, when the girl loves Shankar, Shambhu parts ways with him and joins his rival.
Gopi, a humble rickshaw puller, faces love and social prejudice as he pursues a relationship with Kiran, a woman from a higher class, challenging societal norms and personal conflicts.
A young man seeks a fresh start in a village after enduring tragedy, only to find himself entangled in a conflict that tests his strength and sense of justice.
Rahul falls in love with Sandhya, a fellow college student, but realises that she does not reciprocate his feelings. Undeterred by her rejection, he still pursues her but pays a huge price for it.
Shanti and Suraj lead a content life until he abandons her to marry Ruchi. Shanti and Ruchi both give birth to boys, who grow up and fight each other, unaware that they are half-brothers.
Sagar sets out to exact revenge against Dr Narendra, a smuggler who killed his father. But Sagar is soon framed for the murder of a woman and sent to jail.
Ram begins to suspect that his wife, Seeta, is having an affair with his brother, Amar. His doubts persist even after Amar gets married, creating problems within his family.
Destiny entangles Sapna with a bereaved Vicky and his fun-loving younger brother Prem Oberoi in a tapestry of romance, heartbreak, and sacrifice.
After the death of his parent, Kunal lives with his grandfather Shamsher. However, when he falls in love with Durga, Shamsher plans to separate them.

India 1974; Thriller; Dir. Ravi Tandon; Cast: Amitabh Bachchan, Parveen Babi. Ravi leads a good life with his mother & sister. When he learns that he is ill, he falsely takes the blame for a murder.
When Shekhar falls for Roopa, he approaches her father with his parents. However, when his stepmother asks Roopa's father for dowry, he vows to marry his daughter elsewhere.
Lovers Payal and Chetan elope as their families disapprove of their relationship. They start a new life working for Geeta, unaware of her true nature and affiliations.
Vidya and her brother are orphaned and take up odd jobs to make a living, but get separated. However, due to an unfortunate incident, when she loses her vision, she strives to find her brother.
Arjun Pratap Singh, an IPS officer, strives to overcome multiple challenges and embarks on a mission to restore peace in society.
Manisha, a wealthy woman, falls in love with Ajay, a middle-class man, who promises to marry her and settle down within three years. However, after the time period passes, he mysteriously disappears.
A doctor puts out a job posting to recruit a nurse for his clinics in rural India. Unaware of a candidate's dark past, he hires her and eventually falls in love with her.
When Anoop ditches Mangala, she is forced to marry Anand, a blind singer. After seeing Anand's care, she falls for him, but things get complicated when Anoop re-enters the frame.
Ajay falls in love with Ayesha, a fellow college student who is the daughter of a rich businessman. However, problems arise when Ayesha's father arranges her marriage to an associate's son.
Raised by his mother alone, Siddharth dreams of settling in a foreign country. As part of a rock band, Siddharth enters a competition that changes his life.

A man falls victim to a tragic twist of fate, enduring an imprisonment and bearing the weight of his consequences for the rest of his life.
Two meddling friends Bantu and Chantu join a hotel management programme in Goa by pretending to be the owner's nephew and his friend. While training, they expose many employees and guests as frauds.
After his lookalike, Ranjith, convinces Bhola to impersonate him for money, an innocent Bhola soon finds himself in trouble when the police chase after him for Ranjith's crimes.
Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.
When an expelled police inspector, an outlaw and a commissioner's son are implicated by a dealer, they unite to seek revenge and prove they are not culprits.
Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.
Pinky, the granddaughter of a wealthy industrialist, runs away and marries a taxi driver. However, the businessman holds Pinky's lover responsible and gets him arrested.
Falsely accused of murder, Raja becomes a target for Vijay, a police inspector and his lover's brother. In a bid to end his misery and catch the real culprit, Raja sets out on a mission.
Imran, a freelance photographer, meets Asiya, a mysterious woman, on his way to Alipur for an assignment. However, things take a turn when he repeatedly sees her and starts to question reality.
Three brothers, each raised in different religious households, reunite after many years in a chance encounter. They set out to take revenge on those responsible for separating them.

Som's mother sees her son's selection for a singing reality show as a second chance to fulfil her own dreams. However, complications arise when he faces a quick defeat.
Vijay and Ajay make a living by stealing money from people. Their friendship is affected when Vijay discovers that Ajay's father may have been his father's killer.
Shyam, a middle-class man, falls in love with a millionaire's daughter and marries her. However, as their relationship starts deteriorating, Shyam finds solace in the company of Radha.
A decorated school teacher's life is upended by devastating rumours, which ultimately lead to his death. His son Kundan now seeks vengeance.
Suraj, a police officer, is assigned to arrest his friend Yash, whose father runs an illegal business. He must now persuade his friend to make his father change his ways to avoid the consequences.

Joseph D'Souza frames Ghanshyam, an honest employee, for a murder, forcing him to flee from the police and to leave his family behind. Soon, things take a turn as he hatches a plan to destroy Ghanshyam's loved ones.
Asha is impregnated by one of the three men she has an affair with. She moves to Mauritius with her daughter to start a new life, but her past soon comes back to haunt her.

programs.showName: I Proud to Be an Indian
programs.description: I, a man from India, travels to London for a family wedding and finds that their community is being threatened by a racist group. Seeing this, he decides to get involved and fight back.
A man marries his lover and has a child with her against the wishes of her wealthy father. However, his scheming father-in-law ruins their marriage and leaves to care for his boy by himself.
Subir, a singer, encourages his wife, Uma, to pursue a singing career. However, things take a turn when she becomes more popular than him.

A young Sudhir is adopted by Mr Chaturvedi and develops a strong bond with his son, Prashant. Later, when the police arrest Prashant for performing illegal abortions, Sudhir comes to his rescue.
Rajkumari Ophelia hires a thug to steal an idol of Devi Maa that brings good luck to its owner. But the goddess soon begins unleashing her wrath, wreaking havoc in the lives of two noble families.
Rajeshwari considers Rahul to be a perfect match for her sister, Nisha, and invites him to be their tenant. However, she rejects Rahul immediately after she meets Yuvraj, a better match.
Sunderlal and Farooq befriend each other in odd circumstances, but when they meet wealthy Pestonji, they hatch a cunning plan to use him to escape their money troubles.
After being diagnosed with alopecia, a condition that causes rapid hair loss, Enakshi, a young girl, navigates through the trials and tribulations of life.
With the Interpol on their trail, a group of international smugglers lose the shipments with all their treasures in a cyclone. A team is sent to salvage the sunken ship and scuttle the gang's plan.
After the murder of millionaire Ranjit Rai, his mistress Radha is apprehended by the police. Journalist Rakesh teams up with his friends and a skilled defence lawyer to uncover the truth.

India 1982; Romance; Dir. Sai Paranjpye; Cast: Farooq Shaikh, Naseeruddin Shah, Deepti Naval. Rajaram, a middle-class clerk, is secretly in love with his neighbour, Sandhya, but is too shy to disclose his love. He is shocked when his smooth-talking friend comes visiting and soon woos Sandhya.
A young university student's world is rocked when her brief involvement with a wealthy playboy results in her pregnancy.
Karan Saxena, a police officer, arrests Sapna Mathur, a woman accused of killing his fellow constable. Things take a turn when Karan falls in love with her and helps her escape her death sentence.
